nodes.title: Prioritize Security, Privacy, and Auditability for third-party financial-data integrations

Not authoritative for: payments-processing; settlement-and-reconciliation; Banking Domain; lending-product; billing-and-accounts-receivable; corporate-finance; partnerships; customer; user-and-identity.

nodes.title: Operational Case Management
nodes.purpose: A shared and generic enterprise capability for operational case management, investigations, evidence handling, and exception workflow orchestration across multiple domains. Manage cross-domain operational exceptions and investigations that require multi-team workflows, evidence, and audit trails—such as reconciliation breaks, disputes coordination, compliance investigations, fraud escalations, and complex operational incidents. This domain owns the workflow of exceptions, not the underlying product records.
nodes.authority: Owns: Case lifecycle, routing, SLA tracking; Evidence management; Multi-team task orchestration and decision logging; Escalation and exception outcome recording; Triggering actions in other domains; Case records, workflow state, task state; Evidence references and audit trail; SLA metrics and routing metadata. Not authoritative for: customer-service-and-support; payments-processing; settlement-and-reconciliation; Banking; fraud-and-risk-decisioning; risk-compliance-and-regulatory.

nodes.title: Customer Notifications & Communications
nodes.purpose: Decide what communications to send, when, and through which channel, based on events from authoritative domains—ensuring regulated communications are compliant, templates are managed, delivery is tracked, and customer communication logic isn’t duplicated across product systems.
nodes.authority: Owns: Communication rules engine; Channel routing selection; Template selection and dispatch orchestration; Delivery tracking and retry/backoff policies; Opt-in/opt-out enforcement by consuming preference sources; Communication rules and versions; Delivery logs/status and audit trail; Template metadata references and dispatch records.
